output.summary: The zero-deviation count is not evidence of real improvement. Independent QC lot rejections rose on every line (0.8% to 1.3%), and complaints rose from 11 to 31 ppm, with 41 of 58 traced to Line 3. The penalty took effect 1 Feb and reports fell to zero by 17 Feb, before the training launched on 9 Mar, which rules out training. Line 3's output gain tracks borrowed technicians from Lines 1 and 4, not transferable practices, since output per technician-hour is flat. Tubing is contradicted by Lines 2 and 5 using the same tubing with few complaints. Suppressed reporting is supported. The Line 3 model rollout (A1) and discipline (A4) are harmful or premature. Suspending the penalty and commissioning an independent investigation are preferred. Evidence is sufficient to suspend the penalty now.
